# Scraper de Rightmove.com

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/rightmove-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/rightmove-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta dados de anúncios de imóveis do Rightmove.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape RightMove Real Estate Property Data with Python](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-rightmove)
- **Código:** [`rightmove.py`](rightmove.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Property pages](results/properties.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Busca de imóveis do Rightmove para encontrar anúncios de imóveis
- Páginas de imóveis do Rightmove para dados de anúncios de imóveis

## Funções

- `scrape_properties(urls)` → `List[PropertyResult]`: scrape Rightmove property listings for property data
- `scrape_search(location_name, location_id, scrape_all_properties, max_properties=1000)` → `dict`: scrape properties data from rightmove's search api

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import rightmove


async def main():
    properties = await rightmove.scrape_properties(
        urls=[
            "https://www.rightmove.co.uk/properties/173769656#/",
            "https://www.rightmove.co.uk/properties/168083552#/",
        ],
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos:

- **`PropertyResult`**: `id`, `available`, `archived`, `phone`, `bedrooms`, `bathrooms`, `type`, `property_type`, `tags`, `description`, `title`, `subtitle`, `price`, `price_sqft`, `address`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `features`, `history`, `photos`, `floorplans`, `agency`, `industryAffiliations`, `nearest_airports`, `nearest_stations`, `sizings`, `brochures`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`rightmove.py`](rightmove.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"GB"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/rightmove-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_search_scraping`, `test_properties_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
